precision.epsilon_and_m: Characteristic energy and mass of quasiparticles; the source does not specify a galactic species or whether the energy is per atom, condensation energy, optical energy, or rest energy. EM bath frequency nu* is separately named, without epsilon*=hnu* supplied in inspected passages.
precision.mode_type: Normal modes of Psi, under the Psion chapter; cavity mirrors/BNI and Dirichlet boundary. Photon omega=c|k| is explicitly a separate row from stationary psion dispersion. The same mode cannot be identified with a lens photon solely from sharing omega.
precision.normalization: The source calls u_n normalized and uses1/sqrt(2omega_n), CCR and Hamiltonian hbar omega_n(N_n+1/2). A norm measure/physical-field-to-SI amplitude and a galactic occupation/state are not supplied by these formulas.
precision.Q: Q is described as cavity Q (part9:15), and kappa=omega/Q is the loss clock. No value or equation equating cavity Q with the galaxy or modular observer clock is supplied.
precision.units: No explicit global declaration c=hbar=1 was located in these eight texts. Photon dispersion keeps c, psion dispersion suppresses it, Hamiltonian keeps hbar, and other sections label m_eff inkg. SI restoration is therefore a named dimensional interpretation, not a verbatim convention already established by these passages.
precision.transport_scope: A dispersion-based group/traversal time may be derived conditionally for the given Psi modes once their dispersion regime, units, boundary and state are fixed. It is not automatically the observed photon time delay of a lens.

actions: Read-only same selected sources; no additional corpus expansion, scientific execution or data calculation.
